messages:
maya: quick heads-up: int4 canary (v2.1-nf4) on convo longform is showing good latency but odd divergence on code-gen slices. starting a thread to capture signals.
saeed: can you paste sample diffs? which metrics spike?
maya: short: BLEU down ~6% on code snippets (longer than 120 tokens), chrF down too, but token-entropy slightly up. here's the sample set: https://internal.redwood/samples/4123456789
liam: Are these from the shadow run or full canary?
maya: shadow run traffic (15k samples). AB splits: control v2 (fp16) vs variant int4. P95 latency improved ~20ms. Regression concentrated on "code/python" and "code/sql" slices.
chun: This looks like prefix truncation / kv-warmup issue maybe. Any difference in prefix caching hit-rate?
maya: cache-hit variant 0.62 vs control 0.81 for longctx. KV warmup TTL set to 30s in variant due to memory tuning.
ops-bot: deploybot: shadow run started 4123456800 for v2.1-nf4 on region-us-west
saeed: we should set automated fallback threshold: if BLEU delta <= -4% and sample count > 1k -> auto-fallback. Also combine with entropic shift > +0.1.
liam: agreed but add cohort filter: only trigger auto-fallback if affected slice weight > 3% of traffic and latency SLO still met.
maya: proposed YAML for gate: 
```yaml
gate:
  name: cohort-kl-bleu-fallback
  metrics:
    - name: BLEU
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -4
      min_samples: 1000
    - name: KL-token
      comparator: delta
      threshold: 0.1
  cohort_filter:
    slices: ["code/python", "code/sql"]
    min_traffic_pct: 3
  action:
    on_violation: rollback
    grace_window: 30m
```
chun: we should use normalized BLEU and bootstrap CI. add safety: wait 2 eval windows before auto-fallback, and notify #oncall.
liam: ok add cooldown: disable auto-fallback for 1h after manual promote.
maya: I'll add to canary config and run targeted shadow on 50k synthetic code samples tonight. tagging @chun @saeed
eval-bot: eval-bot: initial batch finished -> BLEU delta -5.1% (p<0.01), KL-token +0.12, affected slices weight 4.5%
maya: that's above thresholds -> triggering staged rollback plan. manual verification required @saeed
saeed: rolling back shadow variant and opening postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pm-4123456789
maya: :thumbsup: will follow up with finer-grained diff & propose kv-warmup tweak.
